decisions.reason: Because it builds on the firm’s established postpress offer and remained on its own webpage through 2024, its observed performance likely meets or is close enough to aspiration levels for management to keep it while exploiting complementarities with service, consumables, and modular systems.

Although less prominently presented than a standalone core system, the folding add-on fits the firm’s existing portfolio and has at least one named customer application, so boundedly rational management would likely keep it as a complementary product unless clearer evidence of persistent underperformance emerges.
